description: This file contains unit tests for EventHub cache purge logic and eviction strategy behavior under pressure conditions, implemented using the Xunit testing framework. It defines a test class with multiple test methods to verify cache behavior, purge conditions, and buffer management in an Orleans-based streaming system.

classes.name: EHPurgeLogicTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying EventHub cache purge and eviction strategies under pressure conditions.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_WontPurge_WhenUnderPressure
methods.description: Tests that cache does not purge items when under pressure and purge predicate indicates to purge.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_WontPurge_WhenTimePurgePredicateSaysDontPurge
methods.description: Verifies that cache does not purge when the time-based purge predicate indicates not to purge.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_WillPurge_WhenTimePurgePredicateSaysPurge_And_NotUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks that cache purges items when the time predicate indicates to purge and system is not under pressure.

methods.name: EventHubQueueCache_EvictionStrategy_Behavior
methods.description: Validates eviction strategy behavior, ensuring buffers are purged and returned to pool correctly.

methods.name: InitForTesting
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including caches, eviction strategies, and receivers.

methods.name: GetItemCountInAllCache
methods.description: Calculates total item count across all caches.

methods.name: AddDataIntoCache
methods.description: Adds a specified number of event data items into a cache asynchronously.

methods.name: MakeEventData
methods.description: Creates a mock EventData object with a sequence number.

methods.name: CheckPointerFactory
methods.description: Creates a checkpointer instance for a given partition.

methods.name: CacheFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a cache instance with eviction strategy and pressure monitor.
